purpose: Freeze the exact low-entitlement new_share projection, IPO ballot state, point-in-time timing, formula, capacity and failure rules before any provider request or value.

public_documentation_contract.documented_input_date_role: 上网发行开始/结束日期

canonicalization_contract.row_shape: Exactly ts_code, ipo_date, issue_date and ballot; missing or extra fields are fatal.
canonicalization_contract.supported_instruments: SSE main board and SZSE main board/ChiNext only; malformed or cross-exchange codes are fatal and complete classifiable unsupported codes are excluded and counted.
canonicalization_contract.ipo_date: Required complete valid strict YYYYMMDD date.
canonicalization_contract.issue_date: Required complete valid strict YYYYMMDD date, not earlier than ipo_date, and must map to an accepted local trading session before any factor panel.
canonicalization_contract.ballot: Required finite numeric percentage with 0 < ballot <= 100. Boolean, string, NaN, infinity, zero and negative values are fatal.
canonicalization_contract.exact_repeat_policy: Collapse identical normalized events and count repeats.
canonicalization_contract.conflict_policy: Exactly one IPO event is allowed per supported instrument. A second row with different ipo_date, issue_date or ballot is fatal; identical repeats collapse. No latest row, tolerance, rounding, majority vote or field substitution is allowed.

point_in_time_contract.effective_session: first accepted local trading session strictly after issue_date
point_in_time_contract.listing_age_definition: Issue_date must itself be an accepted local session; listing_age_sessions is inclusive accepted-session count from issue_date through signal session.
point_in_time_contract.exit: third accepted local trading-session close after entry

single_factor_definition.name: ipo_retail_ballot_scarcity_20to79s
single_factor_definition.formula: For a supported stock-day with inclusive listing age from 20 through 79, return -ballot. Otherwise return missing.
single_factor_definition.economic_interpretation: A lower online-subscription success percentage is stronger prelisting retail demand scarcity; negation makes lower ballot rank higher.
single_factor_definition.missing_semantics: Missing outside listing ages 20 through 79 or when no accepted canonical IPO event exists. Missing is never zero, imputed, clipped or ranked.

source_acceptance_and_capacity_contract.failure_policy: Any entitlement, schema, projection, date, ballot, duplicate, coverage, variation, capacity or fingerprint failure terminates the exact mechanism before prices or returns. No field addition, age/window/direction/threshold change, source substitution, retry, rescue or combination is allowed.
